event: Spin-off of Telesites from America Movil
detail: Telesites (SITES) added as a new, independently listed entity.

event: Spin-off of La Comer from Controladora Comercial Mexicana (COMERCI)
detail: Per the official MexDer notice (04-Jan-2016): 'escision de Controladora Comercial Mexicana, S.A.B. de C.V. (COMERCI)... creandose una nueva sociedad denominada La Comer, S.A.B. de C.V.' La Comer (LACOMER) added as a new, independently listed entity. Not to be confused with Grupo Comercial Chedraui (CHDRAUIB.MX), an unrelated retailer already in this study's universe.

event: Spin-off of Sitios Latinoamerica from America Movil
detail: Special notice issued 6 days after the regular Sept-2022 semiannual rebalance.

event: April-2020 rebalance during the COVID-19 market dislocation
detail: The raw ticker-level comparison records four additions and four removals. Two pairs are same-issuer ticker/series transitions (KOFL.MX→KOFUBL.MX and MEXCHEM.MX→ORBIA.MX), so issuer-level turnover is two additions and two removals. The period overlaps the COVID-19 market dislocation; no causal link is claimed.

event: Grupo Elektra removed from the S&P/BMV IPC
detail: Removal triggered by a trading suspension exceeding 20 trading days (regulatory/liquidity event), not by a loss of economic relevance. See S&P DJI press release, Sept 2024.
